verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships official, well-documented SDKs across 50+ platforms (bugsnag-docs-16), with source-available JS/Node/React Native SDKs on GitHub (bugsnag-gh-1, bugsnag-gh-2) exposing clear APIs like Bugsnag.notify(), plus an official CLI for build/release integration (bugsnag-docs-12, bugsnag-probe-4). Missing for 10: no public API reference/OpenAPI spec was found (bugsnag-probe-2) and no independent hands-on review specifically validating SDK integration quality beyond general community praise.
